run_evaluation_from_pkl: run 3D pose evaluation on Human3.6M or 3DPW datasets using precomputed pickle files and an HMR model checkpoint
run_evaluation_cli: run the eval script with --checkpoint and --dataset flags to compute MPJPE and reconstruction error metrics
convert_rotmat_to_angleaxis: convert a batch of 3x3 rotation matrices to angle-axis representation using torchgeometry
review_run_evaluation: review the run_evaluation function to understand how SMPL and SMPLX models are loaded and used for 3D pose regression
refactor_pkl_dir_paths: refactor the hardcoded pklDir paths in run_evaluation to accept a configurable pickle directory argument
